entries.description:
Returns portfolio value grouped by bucket type. By default (no params) returns investment holdings only, grouped by security type — backward-compatible with the #138 behavior.

Optional query parameters:
- include (csv): additional asset classes to union into the result.
  Values: "cash" (depository/checking/savings account balances), "liabilities" (credit card + loan balances as absolute value).
  Example: include=cash,liabilities
- group_by: bucketing dimension.
  Values: "security_type" (default — groups by securities.type: stock, etf, bond, crypto, cash, other, unknown), "asset_class" (collapses into investments/cash/liabilities), "account".
- basis: whether liabilities reduce the grand total.
  Values: "assets" (default — show asset-side allocation only), "net" (net of liabilities).

Each bucket includes: security_type, asset_class (when group_by=asset_class), total_value, percentage, holding_count.
Single DB round-trip; designed as an AI-tool-callable function.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of additional asset classes to include. Each element must be one of: 'cash' (depository accounts), 'liabilities' (credit/loan accounts). Default: empty (investment holdings only, backward-compatible).

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: How to bucket the result. Default: 'security_type'.

parameters.name: basis
parameters.description: Whether liabilities reduce the total. Default: 'assets'.

entries.description: Returns unrealized gain/loss totals and a per-account breakdown. realized_gain_loss_supported is always false — Plaid does not provide per-lot cost basis and the 2-year transaction lookback truncates buy history. Single DB round-trip; designed as an AI-tool-callable function.
Returns portfolio value snapshots between start_date and end_date (inclusive), ordered by date ascending. Each point is one daily portfolio_snapshots row. Use for chart data.

Returns investment income (dividends, interest, and reinvested dividends/interest — all economically income) within a date range, grouped by normalized income type. Single DB round-trip; designed as an AI-tool-callable function.

Returns live portfolio totals (value, cost basis, unrealized gain/loss) computed from current holdings. day_change is derived from the most recent prior portfolio snapshot; null when no prior snapshot exists.

Returns the top N gainers and losers by day_change (today's institution_price vs prior close_price). Holdings with NULL close_price are excluded. Default limit is 5; max is 20. Single DB round-trip; designed as an AI-tool-callable function.
